HDDS-6814.title: ozone s3 getsecret default --om-service-id
HDDS-6814.description:
ozone s3 shell command expects service id in the command.

It should rather default to the service id from the config file
{code:java}
Usage: ozone s3 getsecret [-ehV] [--om-service-id=<omServiceID>] [-u=<username>]
      --om-service-id=<omServiceID>
                   OM Service ID is required to be specified for OM HA cluster
{code}

commits.message: HDDS-6814. Using service ID as default for HA if there is only 1 service ID configured.
